t: Pressure Tubes are the primary device in $(pncr) for transporting compressed air between compressors and machines.$(p)Unconnected tubes will leak air! However, the sides of a tube can be toggled open or shut by right-clicking with a $(l:tools/pneumatic_wrench)Pneumatic Wrench/$. Wrenches from other mods may also work.
压力管道是$(#228)气动工艺$()中用于在压缩机与机器之间传输压缩空气的主要装置。$(p)未连接的管道会漏气！不过，使用$(l:tools/pneumatic_wrench)气动扳手/$右键单击即可切换管道各侧的开启或关闭状态。其他模组的扳手也可能有效。

$(italic)Two Pressure Tubes with a $(l:tubes/pressure_gauge_module)Pressure Gauge/$ $(italic)connecting an $(l:compressors/air_compressor)Air Compressor/$ $(italic)and $(l:machines/air_cannon)Air Cannon/$
$(italic)两根带有$(l:tubes/pressure_gauge_module)压力表/$的压力管道，$(italic)连接着$(l:compressors/air_compressor)空气压缩机/$$(italic)和$(l:machines/air_cannon)空气炮/$

Pressure Tubes can be fitted with $(l:tubes/tube_modules)Tube Modules/$, attachable components which add various types of functionality to the tube. See the individual pages for each module for more information.$(p)Pressure Tubes can be concealed with a $(l:tools/camo_applicator)Camouflage Applicator/$.
压力管道可以安装$(l:tubes/tube_modules)管道模块/$，这些可附加的组件会为管道增加各种功能。有关各个模块的更多信息，请参阅其对应页面。$(p)压力管道还可以使用$(l:tools/camo_applicator)伪装涂覆器/$进行伪装。

There are three $(l:base_concepts/pressure_tiers)tiers/$ of tube:$(br)$(li)Tier 1 tubes can contain up to 5 bar of pressure, and have a capacity of 1000mL of air.$(li)Tier 1.5 (Reinforced) tubes can handle up to 10 bar of pressure and also have a capacity of 1000mL.$(li)Tier 2 (Advanced) tubes can handle up to 20 bar of pressure and have a capacity of 4000mL of air.
管道共有三种$(l:base_concepts/pressure_tiers)等级/$：$(br)$(li)1 级管道最多可承受 5 bar 压力，空气容量为 1000mL。$(li)1.5 级（强化）管道最多可承受 10 bar 压力，容量同样为 1000mL。$(li)2 级（高级）管道最多可承受 20 bar 压力，空气容量为 4000mL。
